sections.text_helper: Section 66.7.12 "LPUART transmit data register (LPUART_TDR)" in chapter 66 (Low-power universal asynchronous receiver transmitter (LPUART)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3422.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 8:0 TDR[8:0]: Transmit data value
Contains the data character to be transmitted.
The TDR register provides the parallel interface between the internal bus and the output shift
register (see Section66.4.1: LPUART block diagram).
When transmitting with the parity enabled (PCE bit set to 1 in the LPUART_CR1 register),
the value written in the MSB (bit 7 or bit 8 depending on the data length) has no effect
because it is replaced by the parity.
Note: This register must be written only when TXE/TXFNF=1.
